Thin Wrapper: gt IRR Table from a Simple Poisson Result

Source: R/gt_irr_table.R
mysterycall_model_gt.Rd

Extracts $irr_table from a mysterycall_simple_poisson object and passes it to mysterycall_irr_table().

Usage

mysterycall_model_gt(poisson_result, ...)

Arguments

poisson_result

An object of class mysterycall_simple_poisson (returned by mysterycall_simple_poisson()).

...

Additional arguments passed to mysterycall_irr_table().

Value

A gt_tbl object.

See also

mysterycall_irr_table(), mysterycall_simple_poisson()

Examples

if (requireNamespace("gt", quietly = TRUE)) {
  set.seed(7)
  df <- data.frame(
    days      = rpois(60, 14),
    insurance = rep(c("BCBS", "Medicaid"), 30)
  )
  res <- mysterycall_simple_poisson(df, "days", "insurance",
                                    reference = "BCBS")
  mysterycall_model_gt(res)
}
#> Fitting simple Poisson GLM: days ~ insurance
